label: The whole dataset on one screen
caption: The landing is one calm screen in data-ui's language: the 15 headline numbers as one sheet (Overview only; the code id on hover), every joint's position × speed plane as small multiples, the tool from above, the front and the side at one metric scale, where it points on an equal-area disk, each with its legend, and the who list beside them.

label: Click a plane cell: who made it
caption: A click on shoulder_pan's q 0–20°, qd 0–15 °/s cell writes a plain-words chip under the tabs and frames the cell; the who list keeps the 8 trajectories that visit it, and every figure fades the cells none of the 8 visits.

label: AND a tool pixel
caption: A click on the tool seen from the front (x 0–20 mm, z 620–640 mm) ANDs a second chip: 1 of 54 trajectories does both, the who list shows it, and every figure keeps full colour only where that one trajectory went.

label: Drill in, Open in Rerun
caption: A row opens data-ui's side peek as a drawer over the figures' right edge: Open in Rerun (with the command and Copy), its numbers, what it alone adds (first-visit and only-it cells, inked on every joint's plane), and below its tool path, its joints over time and its spans against the set; ‹ › steps through the answer.

label: The gear repaints everything
caption: Colour map, Reverse and Scale live behind one gear, top right: picking cividis repaints every coverage figure on every tab at once, and the question (the chips, the fade) stays as it was.
